findings.title: Oracle outcome encoding is inverted and completely untested
findings.description: oracle.ts line 43: outcome = metric >= milestoneThreshold ? 1 : 0. The entire codebase defines 0=YES and 1=NO (schema.ts:106, resolve route, all UI components). The oracle encodes milestone-met as outcome=1 (NO), so every auto-resolved market pays NO holders. No test file exists for oracle.ts.
findings.evidence: schema.ts:106: outcome integer 0=YES 1=NO; oracle.ts:43: metric >= milestoneThreshold ? 1 : 0
findings.missing_test_scenario: milestone met should produce outcome=0 (YES); current code produces outcome=1 (NO)

findings.title: distributePayout has zero test coverage
findings.description: payout.ts is never imported by any test file. Three critical untested branches: (1) idempotency early-return when alreadyPaid set is populated; (2) outcome=0 selects YES holders vs outcome=1 selects NO holders; (3) payout amount equals raw share count not cost basis.
missing_test_scenarios: calling twice for same market credits balances exactly once
outcome=0 pays only outcome=0 positions ignores outcome=1
no winning positions returns without SQL

findings.title: refundPositions has zero test coverage
findings.description: refundPositions in payout.ts is completely untested. Key gaps: (1) refundAmount = shares * avgCostBasis formula; (2) shares-zeroing UPDATE is the idempotency guard; (3) zero-refund positions are silently skipped.

findings.title: Oracle uses only latest poll; any-poll-ever semantics neither implemented nor tested
findings.description: oracle.ts queries only the most-recent poll (LIMIT 1). Polls [below,above,below] resolve NO. Required semantics: any poll above threshold resolves YES. No test documents or verifies either semantic.
missing_test_scenarios: poll sequence [below,above,below] -- current impl resolves NO
any poll exceeding threshold should produce YES under required semantics

findings.title: Concurrent oracle calls: distributePayout called unconditionally regardless of UPDATE affected rows
findings.description: oracle.ts WHERE status=resolving guards the UPDATE but distributePayout is called unconditionally after. Under read-committed isolation two concurrent transactions can both pass the alreadyPaid check before either commits.
missing_test_scenarios: two simultaneous resolveMarket calls produce payouts equal to exactly one resolution

findings.title: Admin resolve route has no test coverage
findings.description: route.ts at [id]/resolve has no test file. Six branches: 401, 400 invalid JSON, 400 schema, 404 not found, 422 wrong status, 200 success. The 422 branch prevents re-resolving resolved markets.

residual_risks.title: Oracle outcome inversion pays NO holders on YES-winning markets
residual_risks.description: Inverted encoding in oracle.ts (1 for milestone met) is a live bug on every cron-resolved market. Manual admin route unaffected.
residual_risks.likelihood: certain on any cron-resolved market that hits its milestone
residual_risks.mitigation: Fix oracle.ts line 43 to 0 for milestone-met; add test asserting outcome=0 when metric >= threshold

residual_risks.title: Double-payout possible under concurrent cron runs
residual_risks.description: distributePayout alreadyPaid check reads coin_transactions inside the same transaction. Under read-committed isolation two concurrent transactions may both see empty coin_transactions and double-pay.
residual_risks.likelihood: low but non-zero under overlapping cron runs
residual_risks.mitigation: Check UPDATE affected rows before calling distributePayout, or add unique constraint on (reference_id, user_id, type)

residual_risks.title: refundPositions relies solely on shares zeroing for idempotency
residual_risks.description: Unlike distributePayout, refundPositions has no coin_transactions pre-flight check. Partial failures leaving shares non-zero allow duplicate refunds on retry.
residual_risks.mitigation: Add idempotency test; consider coin_transactions pre-flight check

distributePayout outcome=0 pays only YES holders
distributePayout outcome=1 pays only NO holders
distributePayout no winners returns without DB writes
